title: S4-NEW-12 — Colors by keyboard.
goal: In Colors, arrow keys and End move along the palette swatches and Enter applies the swatch reached, which shows in the Primary well; Escape closes Colors and returns focus to the Primary well, so Enter reopens Colors. The artwork never changes.

steps.why: Clicking a swatch applies it and puts keyboard focus on it.
Left moved to the previous swatch and Enter applied it.
End reached the last swatch and Enter applied it.
Focus went back to the Primary well, so Enter reopens Colors.
